def compute_fourin_grid_functions(*, grid_data, profiles, interval, modelk=0):
    """Compute FOURIN plasma grid functions ``A0..A11`` for one interval.

    This ports the plasma branches of Fortran ``FOURIN`` for reduced and
    physical kinetic energy models: NI (``modelk`` 0/2) and KO (``modelk`` 1/3).
    """

    if modelk not in {0, 1, 2, 3}:
        raise ValueError("modelk must be one of 0, 1, 2, 3.")
    sigmab = _grid_array(grid_data, "sigmab")[:, interval]
    sigbs = _grid_array(grid_data, "sigbs")[:, interval]
    gstl = _grid_array(grid_data, "gstl")[:, interval]
    gssl = _grid_array(grid_data, "gssl")[:, interval]
    gssu = _grid_array(grid_data, "gssu")[:, interval]
    bjac = _grid_array(grid_data, "bjac")[:, interval]
    bjacs = _grid_array(grid_data, "bjacs")[:, interval]
    parjp = _grid_array(grid_data, "parjp")[:, interval]
    gspl = _grid_array(grid_data, "gspl")[:, interval] if "gspl" in grid_data else None
    ftp = np.asarray(profiles["ftp"], dtype=float)[interval]
    fpp = np.asarray(profiles["fpp"], dtype=float)[interval]
    ftpp = np.asarray(profiles.get("ftpp", np.zeros_like(profiles["ftp"])), dtype=float)[interval]
    fppp = np.asarray(profiles.get("fppp", np.zeros_like(profiles["ftp"])), dtype=float)[interval]
    ci = np.asarray(profiles["ci"], dtype=float)[interval]
    cj = np.asarray(profiles["cj"], dtype=float)[interval]
    pp = np.asarray(profiles["pp"], dtype=float)[interval]
    sqgbsq = cj * fpp - ci * ftp
    if abs(ftp) < 1e-14:
        raise ValueError("FOURIN grid functions encountered near-zero ftp denominator.")
    if abs(sqgbsq) < 1e-14:
        raise ValueError("FOURIN grid functions encountered near-zero SQGBSQ denominator.")
    if np.any(np.abs(sigmab) < 1e-14):
        raise ValueError("FOURIN grid functions encountered near-zero sigmab denominator.")
    gsplm = (sigbs / sigmab - fpp * gstl) / ftp
    if modelk in {1, 3}:
        taub = _grid_array(grid_data, "taub")[:, interval]
        gparp = _grid_array(grid_data, "gparp")[:, interval]
        gperp = _grid_array(grid_data, "gperp")[:, interval]
        parkur = _grid_array(grid_data, "parkur")[:, interval]
        pphotj = _grid_array(grid_data, "pphotj")[:, interval]
        if np.any(np.abs(taub) < 1e-14):
            raise ValueError("KO FOURIN grid functions encountered near-zero taub denominator.")
        sigtau = sigmab / taub
        t8 = cj * fppp - ci * ftpp
        if "cjp" in profiles and "cip" in profiles:
            t8 = t8 + np.asarray(profiles["cjp"], dtype=float)[interval] * fpp - np.asarray(profiles["cip"], dtype=float)[interval] * ftp
        pgradt = bjac * pp * (1.0 + sigtau) + gparp + sigtau * gperp
        funcs = {
            "a0": 1.0 / sigtau,
            "a1": sigbs / sigtau,
            "a2": pp * bjac + gperp,
            "a3": sigmab * gssl - (1.0 - 1.0 / sigtau) * sigbs * sigbs / sqgbsq,
            "a4": sigmab * (ci * gstl + cj * gsplm),
            "a5": parkur,
            "a6": gssu,
            "a7": (pgradt * bjacs) / (1.0 + sigtau)
            - (((gparp - gperp) * (pgradt + t8)) / (1.0 + sigtau) + sigbs * pphotj)
            / sqgbsq,
        }
    else:
        funcs = {
            "a0": 1.0 / sigmab,
            "a1": sigbs / sigmab,
            "a2": pp * bjac,
            "a3": gssl,
            "a4": ci * gstl + cj * gsplm,
            "a5": parjp,
            "a6": gssu / sigmab,
            "a7": pp * bjac * bjacs,
        }
    if modelk in {2, 3}:
        if gspl is None:
            raise ValueError("physical kinetic energy models require grid_data['gspl'] for A11.")
        funcs["a8"] = bjac * bjac * gssl
        funcs["a10"] = bjac * bjac * funcs["a6"] / sqgbsq
        funcs["a11"] = -bjac * bjac * (ci * gstl + cj * gspl) / sqgbsq
    else:
        zeros = np.zeros_like(sigmab)
        funcs["a8"] = zeros
        funcs["a10"] = zeros
        funcs["a11"] = zeros
    return funcs


def accumulate_fourin_integrals_from_grid_functions(*, functions, tsc, tss, bjac):
    """Accumulate one-interval ``cna``/``cnb`` from FOURIN grid functions.

    This ports the visible summation loops after ``A0..A11`` construction in
    Fortran ``FOURIN``.  The trigonometric tables are expected in TERPSICHORE's
    ``(lss, njk)`` layout.
    """

    tsc = np.asarray(tsc, dtype=float)
    tss = np.asarray(tss, dtype=float)
    bjac = np.asarray(bjac, dtype=float)
    if tsc.shape != tss.shape:
        raise ValueError("tsc and tss must have the same shape.")
    if bjac.shape != (tsc.shape[1],):
        raise ValueError("bjac must have shape (njk,).")
    lss_with_sentinel = tsc.shape[0]
    cna = np.zeros((7, lss_with_sentinel))
    cnb = np.zeros((7, lss_with_sentinel))
    cna[1] = tsc @ np.asarray(functions["a2"], dtype=float)
    cna[2] = tsc @ np.asarray(functions["a6"], dtype=float)
    cna[3] = tsc @ np.asarray(functions["a7"], dtype=float)
    cna[4] = tsc @ np.asarray(functions["a5"], dtype=float)
    cna[5] = tsc @ bjac
    cna[6] = tsc @ np.asarray(functions["a0"], dtype=float)
    cnb[1] = tss @ np.asarray(functions["a1"], dtype=float)
    cnb[3] = tss @ np.asarray(functions["a4"], dtype=float)
    cnb[4] = tss @ np.asarray(functions["a10"], dtype=float)
    cnb[2] = tsc @ np.asarray(functions["a3"], dtype=float)
    cnb[5] = tsc @ np.asarray(functions["a8"], dtype=float)
    cnb[6] = tsc @ np.asarray(functions["a11"], dtype=float)
    return cna, cnb



def compute_fourin_integral_arrays_from_grid(
    *, grid_data, profiles, trig_table, modelk=0
):
    """Compute raw FOURIN ``cna``/``cnb`` integral arrays from grid data."""

    intervals = np.asarray(profiles["ftp"]).size
    lss_with_sentinel = trig_table.lss + 1
    cna = np.zeros((7, lss_with_sentinel, intervals))
    cnb = np.zeros((7, lss_with_sentinel, intervals))
    bjac = np.asarray(grid_data["bjac"], dtype=float)
    for interval in range(intervals):
        functions = compute_fourin_grid_functions(
            grid_data=grid_data, profiles=profiles, interval=interval, modelk=modelk
        )
        cna_i, cnb_i = accumulate_fourin_integrals_from_grid_functions(
            functions=functions,
            tsc=trig_table.tsc,
            tss=trig_table.tss,
            bjac=bjac[:, interval],
        )
        cna[:, :, interval] = cna_i
        cnb[:, :, interval] = cnb_i
    return cna, cnb

"""TERPSICHORE trigonometric tables and mode-pair lookup utilities."""

from dataclasses import dataclass

import numpy as np


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TerpsichoreTrigTable:
    """STABIN/cospol-style trigonometric lookup table for stability modes."""

    lsx: dict
    msx: np.ndarray
    nsx: np.ndarray
    tss: np.ndarray
    tsc: np.ndarray
    pol: np.ndarray
    tor: np.ndarray
    nper: int

    @property
    def lss(self):
        return self.msx.size

    def lookup(self, m, n_reduced, parity=0):
        return self.lsx[(int(m), int(n_reduced), int(parity))]


def _fortran_divisible(value, nper):
    return value - int(value / nper) * nper == 0


def build_lsx_lookup(mode_table, nper):
    """Build TERPSICHORE ``lsx/msx/nsx`` lookup for difference and sum modes."""

    if nper <= 0:
        raise ValueError("nper must be positive.")
    ms = np.asarray(mode_table.m, dtype=int)
    ns = np.asarray(mode_table.n, dtype=int)
    lsx = {}
    msx = []
    nsx = []
    seen = set()
    for sign in (-1, 1):
        for lc in range(mode_table.size):
            for lr in range(mode_table.size):
                mval = int(ms[lc] + sign * ms[lr])
                nval = int(ns[lc] + sign * ns[lr])
                if not _fortran_divisible(nval, nper):
                    continue
                n_reduced = int(nval / nper)
                key = (mval, n_reduced)
                if key in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add(key)
                msx.append(mval)
                nsx.append(nval)
                # Store Fortran-style packed indices. Index 0 is a zero-valued
                # sentinel in CNA/CNB/TSS/TSC, while physical modes start at 1.
                # Fortran only fills parity 0; parity 1 remains the zero
                # sentinel used when sums/differences are not divisible by nper.
                lsx[(mval, n_reduced, 0)] = len(msx)
                lsx.setdefault((mval, n_reduced, 1), 0)
    return lsx, np.asarray(msx, dtype=int), np.asarray(nsx, dtype=int)


def build_poloidal_toroidal_grid(nj, nk, nper, tpi=2 * np.pi):
    """Build TERPSICHORE ``POL`` and ``TOR`` arrays using cospol indexing."""

    if nj <= 0 or nk <= 0 or nper <= 0:
        raise ValueError("nj, nk and nper must be positive.")
    njk = nj * nk
    dth = 1.0 / nj
    dph = 1.0 / nk
    pol = np.empty(njk)
    tor = np.empty(njk)
    for jk in range(njk):
        pol[jk] = tpi * dth * (jk % nj)
        tor[jk] = tpi * dph * (jk // nj) / nper
    return pol, tor


def build_trig_table(mode_table, *, nj, nk, nper, pol=None, tor=None):
    """Build ``TSS``/``TSC`` tables for FOURIN native coefficient generation."""

    lsx, msx, nsx = build_lsx_lookup(mode_table, nper=nper)
    if pol is None or tor is None:
        pol, tor = build_poloidal_toroidal_grid(nj, nk, nper)
    else:
        pol = np.asarray(pol, dtype=float)
        tor = np.asarray(tor, dtype=float)
        if pol.shape != tor.shape:
            raise ValueError("pol and tor must have the same shape.")
    lss = len(msx)
    tss = np.zeros((lss + 1, pol.size))
    tsc = np.zeros((lss + 1, pol.size))
    for idx, (mval, nval) in enumerate(zip(msx, nsx), start=1):
        phase = mval * pol - nval * tor
        tss[idx] = np.sin(phase)
        tsc[idx] = np.cos(phase)
    return TerpsichoreTrigTable(
        lsx=lsx, msx=msx, nsx=nsx, tss=tss, tsc=tsc, pol=pol, tor=tor, nper=nper
    )

return cna, cnb


def compute_fourin_vacuum_integral_arrays_from_grid(*, vacuum_grid_data, trig_table):
    """Compute vacuum-domain raw ``cna``/``cnb`` arrays for TERPSICHORE ``FOURIN``.

    The vacuum branch requires ``gppl``, ``gtpl``, ``gttl``, ``gstl``, ``gssl``
    and ``gssu`` on pseudo-vacuum intervals ``ni+1..nvi``. Callers must provide
    the complete metric terms from strict vacuum geometry reconstruction.
    """

    required = ("gppl", "gtpl", "gttl", "gstl", "gssl", "gssu")
    missing = [name for name in required if vacuum_grid_data.get(name) is None]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(
            "vacuum FOURIN requires metric arrays "
            + ", ".join(required)
            + f"; missing {tuple(missing)}"
        )
    arrays = {name: np.asarray(vacuum_grid_data[name], dtype=float) for name in required}
    shapes = {name: value.shape for name, value in arrays.items()}
    if len(set(shapes.values())) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"vacuum metric arrays must have identical shapes, got {shapes}")
    points, intervals = next(iter(shapes.values()))
    if trig_table.tsc.shape[1] != points or trig_table.tss.shape[1] != points:
        raise ValueError("vacuum metric point count must match trigonometric tables.")
    lss_with_sentinel = trig_table.lss + 1
    cna = np.zeros((7, lss_with_sentinel, intervals))
    cnb = np.zeros((7, lss_with_sentinel, intervals))
    cna[1] = trig_table.tsc @ arrays["gppl"]
    cna[2] = trig_table.tsc @ arrays["gtpl"]
    cna[3] = trig_table.tsc @ arrays["gttl"]
    cnb[1] = trig_table.tss @ arrays["gstl"]
    cnb[2] = trig_table.tsc @ arrays["gssl"]
    cnb[3] = trig_table.tss @ arrays["gssu"]
    return cna, cnb


def map_fourin_vacuum_integrals_to_coefficients(
    *, cna, cnb, mode_table, nper, lsx, dtdp, cospar
):
    """Map vacuum ``cna``/``cnb`` integrals to ``c1..c6`` coefficients."""

    cna = np.asarray(cna, dtype=float)
    cnb = np.asarray(cnb, dtype=float)
    if cna.shape != cnb.shape or cna.ndim != 3:
        raise ValueError("cna and cnb must be rank-3 arrays with identical shape.")
    lmns = mode_table.size
    intervals = cna.shape[2]
    shape = (lmns, lmns, intervals)
    coeffs = {name: np.zeros(shape) for name in ALL_COEFFICIENTS}
    indices = compute_fourin_mapping_indices(mode_table, nper=nper, lsx=lsx)
    ld = indices["ld"]
    lp = indices["lp"]
    for interval in range(intervals):
        coeffs["c1"][:, :, interval] = dtdp * (
            cna[1, ld, interval] - cospar * cna[1, lp, interval]
        )
        coeffs["c2"][:, :, interval] = dtdp * (
            cna[2, ld, interval] - cospar * cna[2, lp, interval]
        )
        coeffs["c6"][:, :, interval] = dtdp * (
            cna[3, ld, interval] - cospar * cna[3, lp, interval]
        )
        coeffs["c4"][:, :, interval] = dtdp * (
            cnb[1, ld, interval] + cospar * cnb[1, lp, interval]
        )
        coeffs["c3"][:, :, interval] = dtdp * (
            cnb[2, ld, interval] + cospar * cnb[2, lp, interval]
        )
        coeffs["c5"][:, :, interval] = dtdp * (
            cnb[3, ld, interval] + cospar * cnb[3, lp, interval]
        )
    return TerpsichoreCoefficientData(coefficients=coeffs, fixed_boundary=False)


def map_fourin_vacuum_grid_to_coefficients(
    *, vacuum_grid_data, mode_table, trig_table, dtdp=1.0, cospar=1.0
):
    """Compute vacuum ``FOURIN`` coefficients from pseudo-vacuum metric data."""

    cna, cnb = compute_fourin_vacuum_integral_arrays_from_grid(
        vacuum_grid_data=vacuum_grid_data, trig_table=trig_table
    )

"""DESC equilibrium adapters for TERPSICHORE-native stability analysis."""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field

import numpy as np

from desc.grid import LinearGrid

from .options import TerpsichoreOptions
from .radial import TerpsichoreRadialGrid
from .vacuum import build_vacmet_inputs, vacmet_boundary_from_geometry


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TerpsichoreEquilibriumData:
    """Equilibrium quantities needed by the TERPSICHORE migration layer."""

    grid: object
    radial_grid: TerpsichoreRadialGrid
    data: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    nfp: int = 1
    sym: bool | str = False
    source: str = "desc"
    equilibrium: object | None = None

    def get(self, name, default=None):
        return self.data.get(name, default)


def _safe_compute(eq, names, grid):
    """Compute DESC quantities together, with a compatibility fallback."""

    names = tuple(names)
    data = {name: None for name in names}
    try:
        computed = eq.compute(list(names), grid=grid)
    except Exception:
        computed = None
    if computed is not None:
        for name in names:
            data[name] = computed.get(name)
        return data
    for name in names:
        try:
            data[name] = eq.compute(name, grid=grid)[name]
        except Exception:
            pass
    return data




class TerpsichoreAsymmetricRepresentationError(ValueError):
    """Raised when an equilibrium outside the supported symmetry domain is used.

    The native TERPSICHORE workflow supports stellarator-symmetric equilibria
    (``eq.sym=True`` / VMEC ``lasym=0``). An asymmetric Fourier representation
    carries independent sine/cosine channels that the native path must not
    project onto a symmetric model, so it is rejected explicitly.
    """


def _full_domain_compute_grid(grid, eq, radial_grid):
    """Return a full-domain ``sym=False`` meshgrid for TERPSICHORE compute.

    TERPSICHORE geometry, the DESC-to-Boozer angular transform, and the FOURIN
    coefficient integrals are all defined over the complete poloidal/toroidal
    domain. A stellarator-symmetric equilibrium (``eq.sym=True``) is exact on a
    full-domain grid; the storage-efficient half-domain ``sym=True`` grid cannot
    represent the Boozer ``nu`` transform and is therefore incompatible with the
    native coefficient path. The caller's radial/angular resolution is preserved
    while the grid is extended to the full domain.
    """

    if grid is None:
        rho = np.sqrt(radial_grid.s_nodes[: radial_grid.ni + 1])
        return LinearGrid(
            rho=rho,

def vacmet_inputs_from_equilibrium_data(
    equilibrium_data,
    *,
    wall=None,
    wall_scale=1.0,
    nowall=1,
    radial_index=-1,
):
    """Build VACMET inputs from ``TerpsichoreEquilibriumData`` geometry fields.

        "R": data.get("R"),
        "Z": data.get("Z"),
        "phi": data.get("phi"),
        "Rs": data.get("Rs", data.get("R_s", data.get("R_r"))),
        "Rt": data.get("Rt", data.get("R_theta", data.get("R_t"))),
        "Rp": data.get("Rp", data.get("R_zeta", data.get("R_z"))),
        "Zs": data.get("Zs", data.get("Z_s", data.get("Z_r"))),
        "Zt": data.get("Zt", data.get("Z_theta", data.get("Z_t"))),
        "Zp": data.get("Zp", data.get("Z_zeta", data.get("Z_z"))),
        "phis": data.get("phis", data.get("phi_s", data.get("phi_r"))),
        "phit": data.get("phit", data.get("phi_theta", data.get("phi_t"))),
        "phip": data.get("phip", data.get("phi_zeta", data.get("phi_z"))),
        "Rst": data.get("Rst", data.get("R_st")),
        "Rsp": data.get("Rsp", data.get("R_sp")),
        "Zst": data.get("Zst", data.get("Z_st")),
        "Zsp": data.get("Zsp", data.get("Z_sp")),
        "phist": data.get("phist", data.get("phi_st")),
        "phisp": data.get("phisp", data.get("phi_sp")),
    }
    boundary = vacmet_boundary_from_geometry(geometry, radial_index=radial_index)
    dsvac = radial_grid.s_nodes[radial_grid.ni + radial_grid.ivac] - 1.0 if radial_grid.ivac else 0.0
    dsvac = float(data.get("dsvac", dsvac))

def _load_runtime_dependencies():
    import numpy as np

    from desc.grid import LinearGrid
    from desc.stability.terpsichore.api import terpsichore_native
    from desc.vmec import VMECIO

    return np, LinearGrid, terpsichore_native, VMECIO


def _run_case(case_id: str, fixture: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    started = time.monotonic()
    report: dict[str, object] = {
        "case": case_id,
        "fixture": fixture.relative_to(TASK_DIR).as_posix(),
        "status": "running",
        "runtime": {
            "python": sys.version,
            "cwd": os.getcwd(),
            "network_expected": "none",
        },
    }

    try:
        metadata = _metadata(fixture)
        report["metadata"] = metadata
        if metadata["lasym"]:
            report.update(
                {
                    "status": "unsupported",
                    "reason": "asymmetric Fourier representation",
                }
            )
            report["elapsed_sec"] = time.monotonic() - started
            return report
    except Exception as exc:
        report.update(_runner_failure(exc))
        report["elapsed_sec"] = time.monotonic() - started
        return report

    try:
        np, LinearGrid, terpsichore_native, VMECIO = _load_runtime_dependencies()
    except Exception as exc:
        report.update(_runner_failure(exc))
        report["elapsed_sec"] = time.monotonic() - started
        return report

    try:
        eq = VMECIO.load(
            fixture,
            L=3,
            M=min(3, metadata["mpol"] - 1),
            N=min(2, metadata["ntor"]),
        )
        grid = LinearGrid(
            rho=np.array([0.5, 0.75, 1.0]),
            M=max(6, min(8, int(eq.M_grid))),
            N=max(1, min(4, int(eq.N_grid))),
            NFP=eq.NFP,
            sym=eq.sym,
        )
        native = terpsichore_native(
            eq,
            grid=grid,
            mode_family=-1,
            M_max=1,
            N_min=-1 if eq.NFP > 1 else 0,
            N_max=1 if eq.NFP > 1 else 0,
            surfs=3,
            ivac=0,
            solver="scipy",
            auto_coefficients=True,
            strict_geometry=True,
            nj=max(8, 2 * int(grid.M) + 1),
            nk=max(1, 2 * int(grid.N) + 1),
        )
        omega2 = float(native.omega2)
        growth_rate = float(native.growth_rate)
        if not (math.isfinite(omega2) and math.isfinite(growth_rate)):
            report.update(
                _scientific_failure(
                    "candidate native scientific chain returned non-finite stability observations"
                )
            )
            report["elapsed_sec"] = time.monotonic() - started
            return report
        report["status"] = "workflow_completed"
        report["observations"] = {
            "omega2": omega2,
            "growth_rate": growth_rate,
        }
    except Exception:
        report.update(
            _scientific_failure("candidate native scientific chain did not complete")
        )
    report["elapsed_sec"] = time.monotonic() - started
    return report


def _write_outputs(payload: dict[str, object], output_dir: Path) -> None:
    report_path = output_dir / "public_multi_equilibrium_report.json"
    summary_path = output_dir / "public_multi_equilibrium_summary.txt"
    report_text = _strict_json(payload) + "\n"
    lines = []
    lines.append(f"run_id: {payload['run_id']}")
    lines.append(f"status: {payload['status']}")
    lines.append(f"started_at: {payload['started_at']}")
    if "completed_at" in payload:
        lines.append(f"completed_at: {payload['completed_at']}")
    lines.append("")
    for case in payload["cases"]:
        lines.append(f"case: {case['case']}")
        lines.append(f"status: {case['status']}")
        lines.append(f"elapsed_sec: {case.get('elapsed_sec', 0.0):.3f}")
        if "error_type" in case:
            lines.append(f"error_type: {case['error_type']}")
        if "reason" in case:
            lines.append(f"reason: {case['reason']}")
        lines.append("")
    _atomic_write(report_path, report_text)
    _atomic_write(summary_path, "\n".join(lines))


def _result_exit_code(payload: dict[str, object]) -> int:
    statuses = {case["status"] for case in payload["cases"]}
    if "runner_failure" in statuses:
        return 2
    if statuses.issubset(SUCCESS_STATUSES):
        return 0
    return 1


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument(
        "--check",
        action="store_true",
        help="compatibility flag; the exit code always reflects the scientific result",
    )
    parser.parse_args()
    cases = (
        ("C0", TASK_DIR / "fixtures" / "public" / "dshape_control" / "wout.nc"),
        ("C1", TASK_DIR / "fixtures" / "public" / "heliotron_primary" / "wout.nc"),
    )
    output_dir = TASK_DIR / "outputs"
    run_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
    started_at = _utc_now()
    with _output_lock(output_dir):
        _write_outputs(
            {
                "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
                "run_id": run_id,
                "status": "running",
                "started_at": started_at,
                "pid": os.getpid(),
                "cases": [],
            },
            output_dir,
        )
        payload = {
            "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
            "run_id": run_id,
            "status": "running",
            "started_at": started_at,
            "pid": os.getpid(),
            "cases": [_run_case(*case) for case in cases],
        }
        exit_code = _result_exit_code(payload)
        payload["status"] = (
            "passed"
            if exit_code == 0
            else "runner_failure"
            if exit_code == 2
            else "failed"
        )
        payload["completed_at"] = _utc_now()
        _write_outputs(payload, output_dir)
    print(_strict_json(payload))
    return exit_code


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# Method Note: From Equilibrium to Stability

## 1. Scope

The native workflow starts with a VMEC/DESC equilibrium and ends with a stability
interpretation. The supported representation for this task is a
stellarator-symmetric three-dimensional equilibrium. An asymmetric Fourier
representation is outside this task's current native scope and must be rejected
explicitly rather than projected into a symmetric model.

## 2. Coordinates and radial surfaces

DESC commonly represents the radial coordinate with `rho`, while VMEC and the
stability calculation use `s = rho^2`. Integer radial surfaces and half surfaces
play different roles: geometry values are naturally available on integer surfaces,
whereas interval derivatives and several stability integrals live between them.
Mixing these grids can produce arrays with plausible shapes but incorrect physics.

## 3. Three-dimensional Fourier structure

A field-period count `NFP` changes the toroidal phase convention and the allowed
mode coupling. The mode table is data derived from the equilibrium and requested
resolution, not a fixed list associated with one fixture. A genuinely three-
dimensional case should preserve coupling between different toroidal families when
the physical Fourier content requires it.

## 4. Geometry and physical reconstruction

The migration layer contains transformations corresponding to VMTOBO, EXTINT,
METRIC, and BOPHYS responsibilities. These stages reconstruct the coordinate
mapping, Jacobian/metric quantities, current-related terms, and curvature-related
quantities needed by the coefficient calculation. The coordinate Jacobian is not
interchangeable with magnetic-field strength or its square.

## 5. Spectral coefficients and operators

FOURIN-like coefficient construction turns real-space physical fields into the
mode-pair tensors consumed by the potential and kinetic operator assembly. The
same mode ordering and radial convention must be used by both operators. For a
full-domain case, plasma and vacuum/wall intervals must be concatenated without
changing the meaning of the boundary data.

## 6. Solver and energy interpretation

The solver operates on the assembled blocks and returns an eigenvector and a
generalized eigenvalue. Interval energy contributions should be computed from that
same eigenvector before reducing to `WP`, `WK`, `omega2`, and growth rate. A finite
number is not evidence of a trustworthy scientific conclusion if an upstream stage
was approximated, skipped, or built from a different representation.

## 7. Evidence policy

The public reproduction reports stage status and propagates upstream failure to
downstream trust. Reference arrays, when used by author-side verification, are
comparison evidence only. They are not inputs to the native calculation.
The current DESC-native stability implementation can load several VMEC/DESC
equilibria and contains many migrated stages, but a new supported equilibrium
does not yet receive one complete, auditable stability analysis from its native
representation through geometry, spectral coefficients, operators, eigen solution,
energy diagnostics, and physical interpretation.

Use the supplied source and public reproduction to complete this multi-equilibrium
native capability. The same implementation must generalize beyond the two public
cases and must fail closed for representations outside the supported symmetry
domain.

def compute_boozer_geometry(equilibrium_data, mode_table, radial_grid, options):
    """Prepare DESC geometry for future TERPSICHORE Boozer kernels.

    This implements the non-invasive DESC -> TERPSICHORE geometry adapter layer:
    data are normalized into ``TerpsichoreGeometryData`` without changing any DESC
    compute path.  The exact Boozer spectral transform used by Fortran ``VMTOBO``
    is intentionally not faked; downstream matrix assembly still raises a
    migration guard until those formulas are ported.
    """

    geometry = compute_desc_geometry(equilibrium_data)
    diagnostics = {
        "mode_count": mode_table.size,
        "radial_intervals": radial_grid.n_intervals,
        "has_full_metric": geometry.has_full_metric,
        "has_magnetic_field": geometry.has_magnetic_field,
        "source_keys": geometry.source_keys,
    }
    return geometry, diagnostics

def _broadcast_geometry_arrays(arrays):
    """Return float arrays broadcast to one common TERPSICHORE grid shape."""

    converted = {name: np.asarray(value, dtype=float) for name, value in arrays.items()}
    shape = np.broadcast_shapes(*(value.shape for value in converted.values()))
